privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: How A to Z Consultants collects, uses and protects your personal information.

p: A to Z Consultants (“we”, “us”) is a business advisory firm based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, and a part of the Alif Group. This policy explains how we handle personal information collected through this website.

When you interact with us, we may collect your name, email address, telephone number, company name, website, city and country, details about your business and the services you are interested in, and any message you send us.

We collect information when you complete our contact, consultation or enquiry forms, when you email or call us, and through basic technical data (such as browser type and pages visited) that is needed to keep the website secure and working.

sections.h: How do we use your information?
p: We use your information to respond to your enquiry, to assess and provide the advisory services you ask about, to maintain our client relationships, to meet legal and regulatory obligations, and to improve this website. We do not sell your personal information.

We may share information with other companies in the Alif Group and with trusted service providers who help us operate our business (for example email and hosting providers), only where necessary and under appropriate confidentiality obligations. We may also disclose information where required by law or by a regulator.
We treat the information you share with us as confidential. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of websites that we do not own or manage, including those linked from our website.
We keep personal information only for as long as needed for the purposes described above or as required by law, and then delete or anonymise it.
Subject to applicable law, you may ask to access, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you, or object to how we use it. To do so, contact us using the details below.

If you are not satisfied with our response to a privacy concern, please contact us with the details of your complaint. We will review it, investigate whether the right procedures were followed and respond to you as appropriate.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.lead: The terms that apply when you use the A to Z Consultants website.

p: This website is operated by A to Z Consultants, a business advisory firm based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, and a part of the Alif Group. By using the website you agree to these terms.

The content of this website is provided for general information and does not constitute legal, tax, accounting or investment advice. Advisory services are provided only under a written engagement with A to Z Consultants.
You agree not to misuse the website, attempt to gain unauthorised access to it, interfere with its operation, or use it to send unlawful, misleading or harmful material.

The text, graphics, logos and other material on this website belong to A to Z Consultants or its licensors and may not be copied or reused without our written permission, except for personal, non-commercial use.
Information you submit through our forms is handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy. Submitting an enquiry does not create a client relationship.
This website uses only the limited technical storage needed for it to work. If we add analytics or marketing cookies in future, we will update this page and, where required, ask for your consent.
This website may link to third-party websites, including those of the Alif Group. We do not control and are not responsible for their content or practices.

To the extent permitted by law, A to Z Consultants is not liable for any loss arising from your use of, or reliance on, this website. We aim to keep the information accurate but do not guarantee that it is complete or up to date.

We may update these terms from time to time; the current version is always published on this page. These terms are governed by the laws applicable in the Emirate of Dubai and the United Arab Emirates.
